subject: SOC2 evidence ask: employee training, background checks, and access removal logs
messages:
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-04T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request — personnel training and verification artifacts for SOC2 review

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for taking this. As part of the upcoming SOC2 evidence intake we need the following artifacts covering the period Jan 2025 — Sep 2025 for a representative sample: 

- Employee security training completion records (export with name, course id, completion date, and pass/fail status).
- Background check summaries (redacted PII ok; we only need verification status and date).
- Access removal / deprovisioning logs for terminated contractors and staff (user id, remove date, systems deprovisioned).

Please confirm whether you can provide a redacted CSV export of training, a summary PDF of background checks, and a csv of deprovisioning events. If retention windows differ by artifact, call that out.

Also confirmer: do you map training artifacts to any SIG/CAIQ control ids? If you have a short mapping table (control -> evidence filename) that helps accelerate reviewer work.

Can you send initial materials by EOD 2025-10-06? Happy to hop on a quick 20 min call if helpful.

Best,
Elena
Elena Ortiz
Senior Auditor, BrightAudit
elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-04T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel training and verification artifacts for SOC2 review

Elena —

Thanks for the checklist. We'll assemble the files you requested. Quick notes up front: 

1) Training records: we can export course completion by user id and date; HR can provide a redacted version that removes SSNs and DOBs.
2) Background checks: third-party vendor provides status and date; we normally redact candidate DOB and candidate ID — we'll include the verification outcome and date in the summary PDF.
3) Deprovisioning: our identity team keeps a deprovision log with system tags; retention is 12 months in the primary archive, 24 months for terminated employee audit traces.

Cc'ing Kimberly and Irene to pull the artifacts. Kimberly — can you export training and BG summary and attach the redacted files? Irene — can you pull the deprovisioning CSV and confirm retention windows and handbook reference?

Plan: deliver initial package (redacted training CSV + bg summary + deprov CSV) by end of day Tuesday 2025-10-06. If anything slips we'll let Elena know and propose a 10/07 delivery.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Trust & Safety
Redwood Inference
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-05T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel training and verification artifacts for SOC2 review

Marcus / Elena —

Attached are two files as a starter: training_completion_export_2025Q3.csv and bg_checks_summary_redacted.pdf. Notes: 

- training_completion_export_2025Q3.csv: columns = [user_id, course_id, course_name, completion_date, status, score]. All user_id values are internal IDs; we removed email and full name per request.
- bg_checks_summary_redacted.pdf: each row = [internal_id, background_check_type, outcome, completion_date]. Redacted DOB/SSN.

Mapping to CAIQ/SIG: we include a short legend row in the CSV header mapping the training course ids to control families (e.g., personnel_security_training -> SIG-PE-3). It's rudimentary but should help. 

If Elena wants full names under a DPA/secure transfer we can arrange a secure transfer and a scanned authorization form from BrightAudit.

Attachments: training_completion_export_2025Q3.csv, bg_checks_summary_redacted.pdf

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Security Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>, Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-06T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel training and verification artifacts for SOC2 review

Elena / Marcus / Kimberly —

I've attached the deprovisioning export: deprov_access_log_202501-202509.csv. A few implementation notes: 

- The CSV contains [internal_id, system_tag, deprov_date, deprov_method, ticket_ref]. Systems are tagged (e.g., git, infra-console, support-dash).
- Contractors: we classify them with a contractor boolean in the identity system; contractor deprovs are included but flagged in the CSV.
- Retention: active logs are retained 12 months; for audit we keep a 24 month compressed archive. Access to archived logs is via our compliance request workflow (ticket HS-1427).

If you need a sample playbook excerpt showing the deprovisioning steps (who does each removal) I can share a redacted snippet and a Drive link.

Attached: deprov_access_log_202501-202509.csv

Regards,
Naomi Feldman
Identity & Access Lead
Redwood Inference
From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@brightaudit.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2025-10-07T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence request — personnel training and verification artifacts for SOC2 review

Team —

Received the three artifacts, thank you. Quick follow-ups before I close the intake: 

1) Contractors: in the deprov CSV I see contractor_flag = yes for ~28 rows; can you confirm whether contractors undergo the same background check process and training assignment as full-time hires? If not, please indicate differences.
2) Do you have a short mapping doc that ties course_id -> SIG/CAIQ control ids? The header note in the CSV helped but an explicit 1-pager would be ideal.

If you can reply with those two clarifications by EOD 2025-10-09 I'll mark this tranche as complete. Otherwise we'll schedule a 20 min call on 2025-10-10.

Best,
Elena
